name: Power Pulse
updatePolicy: The copy running on gus. Plain-file installation excluded from automatic Git updates. Change only on explicit user request. github.com/nixfred/power-pulse is the official source for this host. The charge-limit slider needs msi-ec loaded with firmware=182KIMS1.113 (/etc/modprobe.d/msi-ec.conf + /etc/modules-load.d/msi-ec.conf) and power-pulse-charge-limit.service for the boot restore. See README.
